main_body: Round red cushion seat on a thin grey pole with two dark feet (bar stool)
top_band: Rows 3-4 light pink (#ffb0a0 / #eb7571), then a mid red row 5 and a dark red outline row 6; the ellipse is about 5 rows including its rim, rows 2-6
evidence: The seat is a rounded ellipse that is wider than the pole. From the top it goes light pink, then mid red, then a darker red front lip, then the dark outline. That reads as a horizontal cushion surface seen from above, with a small step to the shadowed lip. Below it the pole and feet are an open support set back under the seat, about 8 rows. This matches the guide's green 'seat top + legs' and not the thin-seat or side-elevation red cases. The cushion is small but passes.

style.evidence: The piece has only 8 distinct colours, against 38-40 in the references and 17-20 colours per tile. The cushion has a reasonable ramp (dark red outline, highlight, light, mid, dark), and its outline is a tinted dark red, so it is not a sticker look. There is no texture, stitching, grain or speckle on the cushion. The pole is a 1px grey line with about 3 tones and no material detail, and the feet are plain dark blocks. It would look noticeably thinner and flatter than the stall and well references, so it fails.
